parsed.reason: This is a perfect example of what the 5-point standard describes. It's ONE warm question ("How did Swim class go?"), explicitly takes the pressure off ("No need to write back if things got hectic"), nothing else at all. Plain, first person, short. No assumptions, no padding, no invented specifics.
